web.name: Heedly
web.description: Heedly listens while you talk and remembers what you said you'd do.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Heedly to use your microphone so it can catch the things you say you'll do.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Heedly to remind you about things when you're near the right place.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Heedly to remind you near a place even when the app is closed.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow Heedly to hear you while you're listening with it.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Allow Heedly to turn what you say into reminders.
